tips.text: If a vessel stops counting kills, clear your other active quests and reactivate Sands of Inaros from the Codex.
Farm Kavat Genetic Codes on the second tomb visit before you kill the Kavats; it is a one-time room.
Bring Ivara with Prowl or a sleep Equinox so the Kavats stay put while you scan them.
Fit your Synthesis Scanner with Vector-Thread, Cross-Matrix and Sol-Battery for the Kavat room.
Run a Resource Booster and a Resource Drop Chance Booster in the Kavat room; both apply.
Kill Kavats with a fully charged Ballistica shot; the specter it spawns can be scanned too.
Scan and kill one Kavat at a time so you never kill an unscanned one, and leave your companion unarmed.
Abort and rerun the Kavat room after a poor early haul; an abort throws away only that attempt's codes.
Use area damage on Kavats that spawn inside closed-off tomb sections.
Bring area damage like Penta or Tonkor for the Tomb Guardian, since it splits every time it dies.
Equip a weak primary before the Tomb Protector spawns; it copies your frame and primary.
Stay out of Operator form when the Tomb Protector spawns, or it copies your Amp.
Break line of sight to stop shadows spawning, and lure the Tomb Protector into the flooded side rooms.
Raise Effects Intensity in Display settings if a vessel's glyph does not show.
Reach Mastery Rank 5 before Baro arrives; missing it at his counter costs a two-week wait.
Expect one of the easiest quest frames; the only regret players share is rushing the Kavat room without farming codes.
